text.tspan: 07 · Rolling out a change: one group at a time, one node at a time
Each step: create the drain file → the /32 is withdrawn and traffic moves to the next-nearest node of the same group
→ change the node → remove the drain file → the checker re-announces after 3 passes (04).
If a change is bad, stop at the soak: only .53 is affected, and clients and the Route 53 rule use .54.
Roll back group A before touching group B.
